feedback_text: The DBMS lectures are well-structured and Dr. Kumar explains every concept with real-world examples. Really enjoying the course.
Lab computers in the DBMS lab keep crashing. Many systems have been non-functional for over two weeks. This is seriously affecting our practicals.
Operating Systems class moves a little fast. Some students find it hard to keep up with the pace of lectures.
DSA lectures are excellent. Prof. Nair uses very clear diagrams and step-by-step walkthroughs. One of the best courses this semester.
The DBMS course has not yet covered normalization and transactions which are important exam topics. We are worried about completing the syllabus.
Operating Systems class is very informative. Prof. Sharma explains process scheduling algorithms clearly.
The computer networks lab is okay. Some machines are slow but functional. Could be better.
Computer Networks theory is well paced. Notes provided by the faculty are very helpful for self-study.
Digital Electronics lab equipment is outdated. Oscilloscopes are broken in half the lab. Please replace them urgently.
Dr. Verma explains digital circuits very well. The examples used in class are practical and relevant.
Signals and Systems is a tough subject but the lectures are decent. Would appreciate more practice problems.
The classroom used for Thermodynamics has broken ceiling fans. It gets extremely hot during afternoon sessions. This is very uncomfortable.
Prof. Patel covers the Thermodynamics syllabus thoroughly. All chapters have been completed on time.
DBMS theory is good but the lab sessions are unproductive because most computers do not have the required software installed.
DSA is a well-organized course. The assignments are challenging and helpful for interviews.
Some chapters in Operating Systems like memory management have been rushed. We would appreciate spending more time on them.
The projector in Room 204 has not been working for the past month. Lectures are hard to follow without the slides being visible.
Overall the Signals and Systems course is satisfactory. Could use more real-world applications in examples.
DSA practicals are well-planned. The lab machines are fast and all required IDEs are pre-installed.
Structural Analysis lectures by Dr. Singh are very engaging. The hand-drawn diagrams are extremely helpful for understanding concepts.
All computers in the laboratory have stopped working for the last two weeks.
Teacher is teaching too fast.
Classroom fans and lights are not working.
The course has not completed important chapters.
Everything in the college is satisfactory.
